description: This file defines data structures, functions, and logic for handling bitmap indexes within a Git repository, including reading bitmap data, managing multiple pack and multi-pack indexes, and performing bitmap-based object reachability calculations.

classes.name: stored_bitmap
classes.description: Represents an entry on the bitmap index, including object ID, bitmap data, and flags.

classes.name: bitmap_index
classes.description: The main structure managing bitmap indexes for a repository or pack, including multiple type bitmaps, external indexes, and cache information.

classes.name: include_data
classes.description: Holds data related to including objects in bitmap traversal, including the bitmap index and sets of seen objects.

classes.name: bitmap_lookup_table_triplet
classes.description: Represents a triplet in the bitmap lookup table, including commit position, offset, and XOR row.

classes.name: bitmap_lookup_table_xor_item
classes.description: Represents an object ID and offset used in XOR chains during bitmap lookup.

classes.name: bitmap_show_data
classes.description: Contains context for showing objects during bitmap walk, including associated bitmap index and base bitmap.

classes.name: bitmap_boundary_cb
classes.description: Callback data structure for processing boundary commits and objects in bitmap traversal.

methods.name: lookup_stored_bitmap
methods.description: Reads the stored bitmap, applying XORs if needed.

methods.name: read_bitmap
methods.description: Reads a bitmap from a memory-mapped region at the current position.

methods.name: read_bitmap_1
methods.description: Reads a single bitmap from the current index position.

methods.name: load_bitmap_header
methods.description: Parses the header of a bitmap index from memory.

methods.name: store_bitmap
methods.description: Stores a bitmap with associated object ID into the bitmap index.

methods.name: load_bitmap_entries_v1
methods.description: Loads bitmap entries from a version 1 index.

methods.name: midx_bitmap_filename
methods.description: Constructs filename for a midx bitmap file.

methods.name: pack_bitmap_filename
methods.description: Constructs filename for a pack bitmap file.

methods.name: open_midx_bitmap_1
methods.description: Opens and loads a midx bitmap index from disk.

methods.name: open_pack_bitmap_1
methods.description: Opens and loads a pack bitmap file from disk.

methods.name: load_reverse_index
methods.description: Loads reverse index data needed for bitmap operations.

methods.name: load_all_type_bitmaps
methods.description: Loads bitmaps for all object types and layers.

methods.name: load_bitmap
methods.description: Loads bitmap data from disk into the bitmap index structure.

methods.name: open_pack_bitmap
methods.description: Tries to open a pack bitmap file for all pack files.

methods.name: open_midx_bitmap
methods.description: Opens a multi-pack index bitmap if available.

methods.name: open_bitmap
methods.description: Attempts to open bitmap from either midx or pack files.

methods.description: Allocates and initializes a bitmap index for a repository.
